title: DIY Designer Bag for $0? 💎 Easy Upcycling Tutorial 🧵 #casualbag #diybag #bagsewing #jeansrecycle
description:
Don’t throw away your old jeans! 👖♻️ I saw this viral denim bag on Shein and decided to recreate it at home. It looks so expensive, but I made it for $0! 👜✨ Want to see the full process from pattern to final stitch? 🧵 The full masterclass is already on my channel! Let’s upcycle together! 

🎬Full tutorial is here (with step-by-step pattern making) https://youtu.be/340FJOi6Fv0
-----------------------------------
🧡Get the PDF patterns, exclusive behind-the-scenes, and personal stories on my Boosty: https://boosty.to/diycraftstv
❤️ My Instagram https://instagram.com/tatiana_diy
•♥•♥•♥•♥•♥•♥•
✂️ Materials ✂️
🔹 Denim fabric (Feel free to upcycle your old jeans! 👖♻️)
🔹 Lightweight fusible fleece (approx. 60g)
🔹 Cotton lining fabric
🔹 8" Nylon coil zipper (approx. 20 cm)
🔹 Metal twist lock clasp
🔹 Decorative rivets (Optional, for that designer look ✨)
